title.value: Search for cheap round-trip flights from JFK

introduction.value: ChatGPT agent returned a table of dates and prices per destination that matched on checking, but gave no booking links so the reporter had to search manually.

method.value: The reporter turned on ChatGPT agent from the + menu in the chatbox. He asked it to search for the best round-trip deals from JFK in January 2026. The agent browsed the web and returned a table of specific dates and prices for each destination. He then checked the results himself.

outcome.value: The flight times and prices matched what ChatGPT listed when he checked them. The agent gave no direct booking links, so he had to search for each connection manually in a separate tab.

notes.value: Plan to look up each itinerary yourself. In the same article, Claude with the Kiwi connector did return direct booking links.

Search for cheap round-trip flights from JFK
ChatGPT agent returned a table of dates and prices per destination that matched on checking, but gave no booking links so the reporter had to search manually.
Done with
GA
ChatGPT Agent
What they did
The reporter turned on ChatGPT agent from the + menu in the chatbox. He asked it to search for the best round-trip deals from JFK in January 2026. The agent browsed the web and returned a table of specific dates and prices for each destination. He then checked the results himself.
How it went
The flight times and prices matched what ChatGPT listed when he checked them. The agent gave no direct booking links, so he had to search for each connection manually in a separate tab.
Worth knowing
Plan to look up each itinerary yourself. In the same article, Claude with the Kiwi connector did return direct booking links.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
Search for cheap round-trip flights from [home airport] to [destination or list of destinations] for travel between [date range] lasting [number] days. Build a table of the cheapest date and price for each destination, with a direct booking link for each. Do not book anything; I will review the table first.
Original source: https://www.tomsguide.com/ai/i-used-ai-to-find-the-best-flight-deals-for-january-one-tool-actually-beat-price-comparison-sites
